task: recover heavy-atom connectivity, bond orders, formal charges, and total hydrogen labels from elements and 3D coordinates
development_domains: GenBench3D Pocket2Mol cross-pocket raw, one deterministic molecule per pocket
selection_rule: Choose the smallest reward on the development domains that attains the best observed Astex and Pocket2Mol L2-isomorphic accuracy without any hybrid-v1-only correct cases in any domain. This selects 1.0 over 2.0 because 2.0 creates two Pocket2Mol regressions.
rejected_component: Hard functional-group constraints were rejected because they reduced L2-isomorphic accuracy in every informative development domain and caused one Pocket2Mol solver/evaluation failure.
primary_metric: L2 isomorphic, unknown net charge, all selected molecules in denominator
external_evaluation_policy: The 500-molecule Phase-2 RCSB set is permanently development-contaminated for Phase 3. Do not run this model on it. Freeze code and selection before constructing a fresh non-overlapping external set, then evaluate once.
